structures.questionTemplate:
A line of length $${scope.x_cm}\text{ cm}$ on a map represents an actual distance of $${scope.y_km}\text{ km}$.

Find the scale of the map in the form $1 : r$. (State the value of $r$)
steps:
Convert the actual ground distance from kilometres to centimetres:
$$${scope.y_km}\text{ km} = ${scope.y_cm}\text{ cm}$$

Divide the actual distance in centimetres by the map distance:
$$r = \frac{${scope.y_cm}}{${scope.x_cm}} = ${scope.r_val}$$
State the scale ratio: $1\text{ cm}$ on the map represents $${scope.r_val}\text{ cm}$ on the ground, so $r = ${scope.r_val}$.

structures.questionTemplate:
The scale of a map is $1 : ${scope.scale_n}$. The distance between two points on the map is $${scope.map_cm}\text{ cm}$.

Find the actual distance between the two points in kilometres.
steps:
Convert the scale ratio to find the actual distance represented by $1\text{ cm}$:
$$1\text{ cm} = ${scope.scale_n}\text{ cm} = ${scope.k_km}\text{ km}$$

Multiply by the map distance:
$$\text{Actual distance} = ${scope.map_cm} \times ${scope.k_km} = ${scope.ans_num}\text{ km}$$

structures.questionTemplate:
The scale of a map is $1 : ${scope.scale_n}$. The actual distance between two towns is $${scope.actual_km}\text{ km}$.

Calculate the distance between the two towns on the map in centimetres.
steps:
Convert the actual distance to centimetres:
$$${scope.actual_km}\text{ km} = ${scope.actual_km * 100000}\text{ cm}$$

Divide by the scale factor $r = ${scope.scale_n}$:
$$\text{Map distance} = \frac{${scope.actual_km * 100000}}{${scope.scale_n}} = ${scope.map_cm_val}\text{ cm}$$

structures.questionTemplate:
The scale of a map is $1 : ${scope.scale_n}$. An island is represented on the map by an area of $${scope.map_area}\text{ cm}^2$.

Find the actual area of the island in square kilometres ($\text{km}^2$).
steps:
Find the linear distance represented by $1\text{ cm}$:
$$1\text{ cm} = ${scope.scale_n}\text{ cm} = ${scope.k_km}\text{ km}$$

Square both sides to find the area scale:
$$1\text{ cm}^2 = (${scope.k_km}\text{ km})^2 = ${scope.sq_km}\text{ km}^2$$

Multiply by the map area:
$$\text{Actual area} = ${scope.map_area} \times ${scope.sq_km} = ${scope.ans_num}\text{ km}^2$$

structures.questionTemplate:
A map is drawn to a scale of $1 : ${scope.scale_n}$. A park has an actual area of $${scope.actual_area}\text{ km}^2$.

Find the area of the park on the map in square centimetres ($\text{cm}^2$).
steps:
Find the area represented by $1\text{ cm}^2$ on the map:
$$1\text{ cm} = ${scope.k_km}\text{ km} \implies 1\text{ cm}^2 = ${scope.sq_km}\text{ km}^2$$

Divide the actual area by the area scale factor:
$$\text{Area on map} = \frac{${scope.actual_area}}{${scope.sq_km}} = ${scope.map_area_val}\text{ cm}^2$$

structures.questionTemplate:
An object measures $${scope.l_m}\text{ m}$ by $${scope.w_m}\text{ m}$. It is drawn on a floor plan with a scale of $1 : ${scope.scale_n}$.

What will be the area representing the object on the floor plan in $\text{cm}^2$?
steps:
Convert the actual dimensions from metres to centimetres:
$$${scope.l_m}\text{ m} = ${scope.l_cm}\text{ cm} \quad \text{and} \quad ${scope.w_m}\text{ m} = ${scope.w_cm}\text{ cm}$$

Divide each dimension by the scale factor $${scope.scale_n}$ to find the plan dimensions:
$$\text{Plan length} = \frac{${scope.l_cm}}{${scope.scale_n}} = ${scope.map_l}\text{ cm}, \quad \text{Plan width} = \frac{${scope.w_cm}}{${scope.scale_n}} = ${scope.map_w}\text{ cm}$$

Multiply the plan length and width to find the area:
$$\text{Plan area} = ${scope.map_l} \times ${scope.map_w} = ${scope.ans_num}\text{ cm}^2$$

structures.questionTemplate:
A region of actual area $${scope.actual_area}\text{ km}^2$ is represented by an area of $${scope.map_area}\text{ cm}^2$ on a map.

Find the scale of the map in the form $1 : r$. (State the value of $r$)
steps:
Find the ground area represented by $1\text{ cm}^2$ on the map:
$$1\text{ cm}^2 = \frac{${scope.actual_area}}{${scope.map_area}} = ${scope.sq_km_per_cm2}\text{ km}^2$$

Take the square root to find the linear distance represented by $1\text{ cm}$:
$$1\text{ cm} = \sqrt{${scope.sq_km_per_cm2}} = ${scope.k_km}\text{ km}$$

Convert kilometres to centimetres:
$$${scope.k_km}\text{ km} = ${scope.r_val}\text{ cm}$$
State the scale ratio value $r$: $1 : ${scope.r_val} \implies r = ${scope.r_val}$.

structures.questionTemplate:
Map A is drawn to a scale of $1 : ${scope.scale_a}$. Map B is drawn to a scale of $1 : ${scope.scale_b}$.

A lake has an area of $${scope.area_a}\text{ cm}^2$ on Map A. Calculate the area of the lake on Map B in $\text{cm}^2$.
steps:
Find the actual area using Map A:
$$1\text{ cm (Map A)} = ${scope.k_a}\text{ km} \implies 1\text{ cm}^2 = ${scope.k_a * scope.k_a}\text{ km}^2$$
$$\text{Actual area} = ${scope.area_a} \times ${scope.k_a * scope.k_a} = ${scope.actual_area_km2}\text{ km}^2$$

Find the area scale for Map B:
$$1\text{ cm (Map B)} = ${scope.k_b}\text{ km} \implies 1\text{ cm}^2 = ${scope.k_b * scope.k_b}\text{ km}^2$$

Calculate the area on Map B:
$$\text{Area on Map B} = \frac{${scope.actual_area_km2}}{${scope.k_b * scope.k_b}} = ${scope.area_b_num}\text{ cm}^2$$
